EftEmit_SpawnType18 passes set->array[1] + n * 0x108, a 16-entry texture set, and the receiver EftArcArg names +0x30 texSet.
The receiver of type 18 (EftArcArg, eft_chain.h) names +0x34 param (EftArcParam): a definition block, not a texture; types 5 and 16 share the argument.
The receiver of type 18 (EftArcArg, eft_chain.h) names +0x38 keys (EftArcKeys): a definition block, not a texture.
The receiver EftRibbonArg (eft_ribbon.h) names +0x38 prm (EftRibbonPrm): a definition block, not a texture.
The receiver EftArcArg names +0x28 life (seconds; <= 0 until told to end); EftRibbonArg names the same slot of type 17 life.

EftHit_Add (eft_core.c) does rec->level = rec->src->def->level from definition +0x02; rec->type is the constant EFT_HIT_TECH.
EftHitDef is the block EftShot_BuildParam fills (EftShotParam, eft_emit.h): +0x05 gets hitDirKind and is named sub there; frees the name kind for +0x04.
EftShot_BuildParam writes 0 skill / 1 technique / 2 ultimate to +0x04, named kind in EftShotParam and eft_obj_tech.h (apply after kind -> sub).

Same block as EftShotParam (+0x34 speed); EftHit_Add copies it to the slot that a ki blast fills with atk->speed.
